A few things to know

Make a night of it

We're off the grid — there's no running water on site. A clean outhouse is available, but there are no modern bathrooms, so plan accordingly.

Admission is free. Donations will be collected to support the event and musicians.

Music runs from 7–10 PM, but you're welcome to hang out all night.

Questions?

Text Andrew or Russ. If you don't have our numbers, ask someone who does.
